title: Should Children Use Phones at School?
text:
In my opinion, children should not use phones in class. Phones can distract students from the lesson. Many students play games or send messages when the teacher is talking. Teachers also find it hard to keep students focused.

Some people say phones help children learn. For example, they can use a dictionary or a map. However, schools can provide tablets for these tasks. Therefore, I think phones should stay in bags during lessons.

questions.text: Why are phones a problem in class, according to the writer?
options: They are too expensive for schools.
They make the classroom too hot.
They can distract students from the lesson.
They are not allowed by law.

questions.text: What do some people say phones help children do?
options: Learn, for example by using a dictionary or a map

questions.text: What can we infer about the writer's opinion?
options: The writer thinks phones should be used in every lesson.
The writer thinks phones should stay away during lessons.
The writer has no opinion about phones.
The writer thinks teachers like phones.

questions.text: Why does the writer mention tablets?
options: To suggest a school alternative to phones for learning tasks.
To show that tablets are more fun than books.
To explain that tablets are too expensive.
To prove that teachers do not use technology.

vocabulary.definition: to take someone's attention away from something
paying full attention to one thing
flat portable computers with a touch screen
short written pieces of information sent from one person to another

paragraph_translations: На мою думку, діти не повинні користуватися телефонами на уроках. Телефони можуть відволікати учнів від уроку. Багато учнів грають в ігри або надсилають повідомлення, коли вчитель говорить. Учителям також важко тримати учнів зосередженими.

Деякі люди кажуть, що телефони допомагають дітям навчатися. Наприклад, можна користуватися словником або картою. Однак школи можуть надати планшети для таких завдань. Тому я вважаю, що телефони мають лежати в сумках під час уроків.
